pages.text: $(bold)Sonar System$()$(br2)The sonar device detects submarines and underwater entities.$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)• Hold the sonar item$(br)• Right-click to activate a ping$(br)• Nearby submarines will be highlighted$(br)• Effective range depends on sonar tier

$(bold)ASW Sonar$()$(br2)Anti-submarine warfare sonar is mounted on aircraft.$(br2)$(bold)Features:$()$(br)• Automatically scans below aircraft$(br)• Detects submerged submarines$(br)• Shares detection data with allies$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Combine sonar with depth charges for effective ASW!
